tool_input.description: Write adopt implementation and build engine

result:
I wrote the `adopt` implementation in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/disposable_stack/prototype_adopt.rs`, but I have not built or tested it. The Bash tool was denied in this session, so `cargo build`, `cargo clippy` and `./t262 built-ins/DisposableStack/prototype/adopt/` have not run.

The code follows the stub's spec steps, with each step's text above its code. The closure captures `value` and `onDispose` as its two builtin slots, and it is registered through `add_disposable_resource` with `~sync-dispose~`. It uses existing helpers only and no new helpers are needed, and no other file was touched. I did not run `cargo fmt`, so formatting is unchecked. The closure reads its slots by index, which matches the existing `dispose.rs` code.

Once Bash is available, the next step is `cargo build -p kahvi-cli`, then `./t262 built-ins/DisposableStack/prototype/adopt/`, then `cargo clippy`.
